scope: Request-scoped TCP refusal detection during playback-paced HTTP PCM consumption

detection_contract.starts: first complete PCM frame before yielding to output
detection_contract.stops: HTTP generator finalization; stop event then thread join before HTTP resource close
detection_contract.scope: this request CancelToken only; no global gate or other source cancellation
not_detected_early: listener still alive but HTTP/inference stalled

environment: Independent PipeWire/WirePlumber graph, RTX4080SUPER Vulkan0, server default warmup on every restart, random default synthesis seed; no VRChat or physical mic.

measurement_boundary.fault: monotonic command timestamp immediately before owned speech server SIGKILL -> first continuously quiet source read frame, with at least two seconds confirmation
measurement_boundary.first_audio: SpeechMessageEvent creation -> virtual source 20ms read frame peak >64/32768
measurement_boundary.precision: read timestamps, not DAC/ADC; 20ms capture and host scheduling limit resolution
measurement_boundary.p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), evaluated at n=30; small sample evidence, not an upper-bound guarantee
measurement_boundary.group_comparability: 50ms and20ms groups are separate sequential runs with same model hash and route. Random seeds and background workload were not controlled; no paired causal speedup claim.
measurement_boundary.background: Python regressions and short probe CPU diagnostic ran during parts of the private repetitions. No FPS/GPU contention guarantee.

provenance.first_smoke_runner_note: Before --crash-repeats and distribution assertion were added; exact runner snapshot not saved. Production provider matches 50ms hash.

interpretation: The50ms group passed its per-case250ms check but missed the100ms p95 target. That failure assessment and all raw results are retained.
The20ms runner also enforces p95<=100ms for30 repetitions. Do not combine the preliminary single trial with either30-run distribution.
Successful probe connections prove only listener availability, not model health. Timeout and other OSError are intentionally inconclusive.
Synthetic mixed-path test does not validate a real VC model. Private source tests do not replace VRChat or Windows acceptance.
